meta.name: codex
meta.description: Codex MCP tool usage, thread configuration, and thread lifecycle. Consult this skill when an agent or skill needs Codex MCP tool reference for code review, plan review, or completion verification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 借助AI助手查代码、审计划并核对完成情况
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需引导AI核对代码与计划结果
copy.tagline_en: Use the MCP assistant to review code, check plans, and verify completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often guide AI to verify code and plans

howto.what: Claude 会参考此技能，调用 Codex MCP 工具做代码审查、计划审查或完成验证。技能规定线程的配置与生命周期：启动线程、继续线程、保存线程 ID，文件访问只限当前项目。
howto.when: 当代理或技能需要 Codex MCP 工具参考，用于代码审查、计划审查或完成验证时。

say.text: 用 Codex 审查当前项目代码，给出修改建议。
say.note: 启动 Codex 只读审查线程，仅访问项目文件。

say.text: 用 Codex 检查这份计划，看看有没有问题。
say.note: 计划审查会以只读模式运行。

say.text: 用 Codex 验证这个任务的完成情况。
say.note: 代码验证线程启动后，结果会返回给你。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Codex MCP tool for code review, plan review, or completion verification. It defines thread config and lifecycle: start/continue threads, store thread ID, limit access to project files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an agent or skill needs Codex MCP tool reference for code review, plan review, or completion verification.

say_en.text: Use Codex to review the current project code and suggest changes.
say_en.note: Starts a read-only Codex review thread.

say_en.text: Use Codex to check this plan for any issues.
say_en.note: Plan review runs in read-only mode.

say_en.text: Use Codex to verify whether this task is complete.
say_en.note: A verification thread will be started.
